name: brain-dump
description: Turns a long, rambling voice dump into a clear, structured prompt before it is sent. Asks short multiple-choice questions about real gaps first, then puts the result in your prompt box to check.

min_words.title: Shortest dump
min_words.description: Prompts shorter than this many words are sent as typed.

format.title: Prompt format
format.description: standard: Goal, Context, Requirements, Constraints, Done when. four-part: THE JOB, THE WHY, THE GUARDRAILS, DONE MEANS.

delivery.title: What happens to the result
delivery.description: review: put it in the prompt box to check and edit, then press Enter. confirm: show it and ask in a dialog. auto: send it straight away.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model alias used to tidy prompts, for example sonnet or haiku.

plain_dashes.title: Plain dashes
plain_dashes.description: Replace long dashes with commas in the result.
